# Hece

> Hece is a free, open-source (MIT) voice-dictation app for Windows. Hold a hotkey (Ctrl+Shift+Space), speak, and the text is pasted into the focused window. Speech is transcribed locally by multilingual Whisper large-v3 turbo or a fine-tuned single-language model (CTranslate2, NVIDIA GPU) or by a cloud provider (OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Deepgram, Groq).

- Quality layers: personal vocabulary, a filter for text Whisper invents in silence, a low-confidence signal, and optional LLM cleanup with a guard that rejects edits which drop a negation.
- Privacy: in local mode audio never leaves the PC; no telemetry; audio, transcripts and API keys are never logged; API keys live in the Windows Credential Manager.
- Also: push-to-talk or toggle mode, local dictation history, a local OpenAI-compatible transcription API.
- Platforms: Windows (64-bit). Linux and macOS are planned.
- Price: free. No account.
